basis: IMMA's governance page calls it a public body and a company limited by guarantee whose directors the Minister appoints, and its memorandum page gives charitable status approved by the Charities Regulator; the public foundation form is chosen because the state controls the board of this company.
The About page, section Governance & Policy, says it is Pallas Projects CLG, a registered charity and company limited by guarantee governed by a voluntary Board of Trustees.

The constitution PDF, page 1, says the company is a company limited by guarantee, and the governance page says the Board of Directors manages the company and that it follows the Charity Regulator's Governance Code.
The governance page says it is constituted as a company limited by guarantee, is a registered charity and is governed by a voluntary Board of Directors.

The constitution PDF, page 2, says The Model Arts and Niland Gallery CLG is a company limited by guarantee, and the governance page lists its Board of Directors and the Charities Regulator's Governance Code.

The company's own job advertisement, section Job description, calls Haifa Museums a public benefit company and municipal corporation wholly owned by Haifa Municipality that runs the city's museums, including the Haifa Museum of Art.
